extracted.name: Slow Cooker Roast Beef
extracted.description: This slow cooker roast beef recipe requires only 4 ingredients and almost zero hands-on time. Just season, cook, and wait until the next day!
ingredient_lines: 1 (1 ounce) package dry onion soup mix
instruction_lines: Whisk soy sauce and soup mix together in a slow cooker until well combined. Place chuck roast into the cooker; pour in water until all but the top 1/2 inch of roast is covered. Sprinkle ground pepper over top. Cover and cook on Low until meat is tender, about 22 hours.
